issue: Must the government prove that a defendant knew the person he persuaded, induced, or enticed was a minor for a conviction under 18 U.S.C. § 2422(b), or is mistake of age a available defense?

sides.position: The government must prove the defendant knew or believed the target was a minor (knowledge of minority is an element).
Mistake of age is an available defense, so the defendant need not know the target was a minor.

quote: We note the circuits have divided concerning whether a defendant must know the individual being persuaded, induced, or enticed was a minor.
cite: United States v. Soler-Montalvo, No. 20-1311P (1st Cir. 2022)
